identitySignals: OEA's own website (oaklandea.org) describes it as the Oakland Education Association, representing nearly 3,000 K-12 teachers, counselors, early childhood educators and other staff, matching the agenda's 'Oakland Education Association (OEA)' and the early childhood workforce MOU

OUSD's own news page states OUSD and the Oakland Education Association (OEA) reached a Tentative Agreement for July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2027, matching the agenda's successor collective bargaining agreement
research.notes: Labor union (teachers' union, CTA/NEA affiliate). Email omitted because the page obfuscates it. profile.summary: The Oakland Education Association is the union of teachers and other school staff in Oakland. Its members include K-12 teachers, counselors, psychologists, social workers, nurses, librarians, early childhood educators and substitute teachers. It bargains contracts with the Oakland Unified School District on behalf of its members.

sources.title: OUSD Announces Tentative Agreement With Teachers Union, Averting Strike

review.notes: oaklandea.org and OUSD's own news page confirm the Oakland Education Association is the OUSD teachers' union that reached the 2025-2027 tentative agreement, matching the agenda items. The summary, website, phone, address and headquarters are shown on the cited About and Contact pages, and the summary is neutral.
